scope: Pinned official SPARQL 1.1 query and result-format manifests

gaps.requirement: GROUP_CONCAT produces the specified simple literal instead of retaining an input language tag.
gaps.nextAction: Implement aggregate evaluation in the NGKG scalar oracle or patch the pinned evaluator behind differential tests.

tests: COUNT: no GROUP BY inside of GRAPH
gaps.requirement: Aggregate empty groups are emitted for every active named graph selected by GRAPH.
gaps.nextAction: Correct GRAPH and aggregation algebra evaluation before distributing the aggregate.

tests: VALUES inside GRAPH binding the same variable as the graph name
gaps.requirement: VALUES bindings constrain and retain the same variable used as the active GRAPH name.
gaps.nextAction: Correct variable-domain propagation across VALUES and GRAPH.

gaps.requirement: BNODE(string) labels are stable only within one solution mapping and never alias across mappings.
gaps.nextAction: Add query- and solution-scoped blank-node allocation to the expression evaluator.

tests: outer GRAPH operator does not affect MINUS disjointness
gaps.requirement: An outer GRAPH variable does not create an in-scope shared variable inside MINUS when algebra domains are disjoint.
gaps.nextAction: Correct MINUS compatibility-domain calculation before distributed lowering.

tests: * with start being a constant on the empty dataset
* with end being a constant on the empty dataset
? with start being a constant on the empty dataset
? with end being a constant on the empty dataset
gaps.requirement: Zero-length path alternatives return the identity solution for a constant endpoint even on an empty graph.
gaps.nextAction: Seed constant endpoint identity before graph frontier expansion.

gaps.requirement: CSV serialization preserves the RDF literal lexical form required by the result-format test.
gaps.nextAction: Preserve source literal lexical identity through storage and result serialization.

gaps.requirement: Arbitrary RDF datatypes, including xsd:negativeInteger, remain distinct from their value-space parents.
gaps.nextAction: Separate lossless RDF term storage from the stricter OWL reasoning datatype policy.
